editionLabel: ABACUSSPIELE English rules, two-page folded-sheet PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went to sea goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player takes the compass card, prepares and deals the round, and plays the first booty card. Play continues clockwise.
